# gi.io_utils.coerce_string { #bedrock_ge.gi.io_utils.coerce_string }

```python
gi.io_utils.coerce_string(string)
```

Converts a string to an appropriate Python data type.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                       | Default    |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------|------------|
| string | str    | The input string to be converted. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                         | Description                                                            |
|--------|------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | None \| bool \| float \| str | None if the string is 'none', 'null', or empty.                        |
|        | None \| bool \| float \| str | bool if the string is 'true' or 'false' (case insensitive).            |
|        | None \| bool \| float \| str | int if the string can be converted to a float and has no decimal part. |
|        | None \| bool \| float \| str | float if the string can be converted to a float with a decimal part.   |
|        | None \| bool \| float \| str | str if the string cannot be converted to any of the above types.       |
